short_description: Leaf Blowing Simulator is a cozy co-op job simulator where you can blow away your worries with satisfying leaf physics. Whether solo or with a crew of fellow groundskeepers, fire up your leaf blower and blow away every leaf in sight. Can you find peace in the clutter of leaves?
